unchanged_requirement.statement: No benchmark robot identifier, link name, or joint name appears anywhere under src/rigby_general/. Ingest and bake configuration is derived from the uploaded model, never authored.
unchanged_requirement.rationale: The anti-cheat half of the goal. Special-casing one robot would make every other number meaningless.

requirements.g02_relationship: The new execution path derives body bindings from ingestion and contains no body-specific joint/link overrides. Full sealed-vocabulary/configuration audit remains deferred.

unchanged_requirement.statement: Every robot compiles to MJCF, yields a RobotMorphologyV1, and passes the inertia and collider integrity checks.

requirements.g02_relationship: The conformance audit ingests all six public zoo bodies. This does not prove ingestion for the sealed release roster.

unchanged_requirement.statement: Derived semantic sites agree with the sealed human-labelled ground truth.
unchanged_requirement.note: Labels are SHA-pinned per robot exactly as benchmark_spec.json is, so the accuracy cannot be raised by editing the answer key.

requirements.g02_relationship: G02 uses ingested sites and does not inspect the sealed human labels; ground-truth accuracy remains unmeasured.

unchanged_requirement.statement: The behavioural gripper test classifies every effector correctly, across at least one parallel-jaw, one multi-finger, and one tool-tip-only robot.

requirements.g02_relationship: No new behavioral effector-classification benchmark is claimed.

unchanged_requirement.statement: Every schema a robot's morphology affords under the declared affordance rule has at least one certified primitive, and the overall certified yield across attempted bindings clears the floor.

certified_binding_yield.note: Lowered from 0.60 after measurement. Yield across regions is a weak signal: an `adjacent` circle on a 0.39 m arm is genuinely infeasible, and refusing it is correct behaviour rather than a shortfall. Coverage -- every afforded schema holding at least one certified primitive -- is the requirement that actually says the robot is usable, and it is held at 1.0. Measured yields: 0.56 to 0.81.

requirements.g02_relationship: No primitive library coverage or certified binding yield is measured by G02.

unchanged_requirement.statement: Bake time and attempt count stay inside their ceilings.
unchanged_requirement.note: Measured on the reference machine described in the operator runbook.

requirements.g02_relationship: Registered episode time/attempt limits are separate from the unchanged primitive baking ceilings.

unchanged_requirement.statement: For the shared cross-robot prompt subset, the role-normalized MotionSchemaProgramV1 hash is identical across all six robots.
unchanged_requirement.rationale: The falsification test for the magnitude-neutrality thesis. Talmy's claim is that closed-class spatial terms abstract away metric shape, size, and distance; if that holds, the language-level output cannot depend on the body. A single mismatch means the semantic layer has leaked body knowledge and the design is wrong -- not that a threshold needs relaxing.

requirements.g02_relationship: G02 checks task-binding equality and resolved world invariance; the 60-prompt cross-body semantic-program hash test is still required.

unchanged_requirement.statement: No grounded program references a DOF, site, or contact pair the target robot lacks, and no grounded metric value falls outside the measured limits.
unchanged_requirement.note: The structural half is already enforced at import time by schema.program.assert_metric_free; this measures the grounder's half.

requirements.g02_relationship: Explicit robot joint-address mapping and missing-sensor refusal protect the observation path. Full prompt grounding limit counts remain unmeasured.

unchanged_requirement.statement: Supported prompts end in a certified, gate-passing, judge-accepted motion.

requirements.g02_relationship: Zero-command infrastructure probes are unscored and cannot count as supported prompt successes.

unchanged_requirement.statement: Adversarial prompts return the expected typed failure, including out-of-morphology requests such as asking a single-arm robot to use its other hand.

requirements.g02_relationship: Mutation and boundary tests exercise named refusals. They do not replace 100 adversarial prompts per sealed robot.

unchanged_requirement.statement: No candidate failing a deterministic gate is ever selected.

requirements.g02_relationship: Actual evaluator regressions reject margin-supported placement and simulation-budget overshoot. Full candidate-selection false-accept counts remain unmeasured.

unchanged_requirement.statement: Three repeats of a certified motion produce a byte-identical trace.

requirements.g02_relationship: G01 supplies replay evidence on its separate branch. G02 is not physically replay-integrated and does not claim the existing three-repeat release gate.

unchanged_requirement.statement: The certifier identity never appears among the judge identities, and the blinded judge agrees with itself under reversed presentation order.

requirements.g02_relationship: Simulator truth is separated from acting observations. This is not VLM judging or judge-order calibration; those metrics remain unmeasured.

unchanged_requirement.statement: Prompt to certified winner, excluding VLM calls.

requirements.g02_relationship: Engineering probe wall times do not establish a prompt-to-certified-winner latency distribution.

unchanged_requirement.statement: Both sealed hold-out robots meet every threshold above within 0.05 absolute of the development-robot mean.
unchanged_requirement.rationale: The other anti-cheat half. Development-set performance proves nothing about an arbitrary robot if the implementation saw the development set.

requirements.g02_relationship: No sealed body identities or outcomes were read. Public seed splits cannot establish this threshold.

unchanged_requirement.statement: Every winner exports to GLB and reimports within tolerance. Robot export is rigid per-link TRS, so there is no skinning or bind-pose error to absorb.

requirements.g02_relationship: No GLB export/reimport is exercised by G02.
